newsitem.title: USA: Actor Charlie Sheen denies battery against girl.
newsitem.headline: Actor Charlie Sheen denies battery against girl.

text.p: Actor Charlie Sheen pleaded not-guilty on Monday to a charge of battery against his girlfriend, who claimed he attacked her at his home.

Judge Lawrence Mira set a March 31 hearing at his Malibu Municipal Courthouse to schedule a trial for the star of "Platoon," "Wall Street" and "Hot Shots." The 31-year-old actor was arrested on Dec. 21 after the incident at his suburban Agoura Hills home and remains free on $20,000 bail.

The son of actor Martin Sheen and brother of actor Emilio Estevez was charged under his real name of Carlos Irwin Estevez. He pleaded not guilty to the single misdemeanor charge of battery with serious injury.
His girlfriend, Brittany Ashland, told authorities Sheen pushed her during an argument and she required seven stitches for a lip injury she suffered.

In a separate civil suit, Ashland alleged assault, battery, negligence, false imprisonment and emotional distress. In the suit filed this month she alleged the actor grabbed her by her hair and pushed her to the floor, knocking her unconscious.
She also alleged Sheen made her remove her blood-spattered dress, refused to let her leave and threatened to kill her if she told anyone about the incident.
